description: Remediation override rule: scan node.recent_window (last 5) for a misconception appearing >= 2 times. 1 hit in 5 does not trigger; 2 hits triggers serve_remediation; remediation_shown_recently=true suppresses; a 2-vs-2 tie resolves to the more-recently-hit belief.

cases.description: 1 hit of MISC_DENOM_ADD in 5 attempts -> does NOT trigger remediation
2 hits of MISC_DENOM_ADD in 5 attempts -> triggers serve_remediation
2 hits of MISC_DENOM_ADD, but remediation shown within 3 days -> suppressed
2 hits of MISC_A and 2 hits of MISC_B. Chronological: A, B, A, B -> B is more recent -> resolves to MISC_B
